one_line_description.quote: Connect HighLevel to your AI assistant, then ask it to find a contact, book an appointment, send a message, update a deal, or schedule a social post.

access_model.quote: API access is available across HighLevel subscription plans. However, certain endpoints and capabilities may require a higher-tier plan.

access_notes.value: API access comes with paid HighLevel subscription plans (Starter $97/mo, Unlimited $297/mo, Founder $497/mo); some endpoints/capabilities are restricted to higher tiers and documented endorsed endpoints may require higher-tier eligibility. Credentials themselves are self-serve: OAuth 2.0 for public/marketplace apps (public apps must be approved to be listed) or Private Integration Tokens for internal/single-account tools; legacy API keys are being phased out. Sandbox (App Test) accounts exist for testing. Official MCP server endpoints are per-client (e.g., /mcp/anthropic/v2, /mcp/openai/v2/, /mcp/cursor/v2/).

sdk_languages.quote: HighLevel now ships official SDKs for Node.js, Python, and PHP so you can stop hand-rolling API calls.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: V2 is the current API; V1 is end-of-support (no new V1 keys, no security patches, bug fixes, or features, no technical support).
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: The option to generate new V1 API keys has been disabled.

verdict_reason: The API is public and well documented: OAuth 2.0 plus Private Integration Tokens, official Node.js/Python/PHP SDKs, webhooks for 50+ events, and a vendor-run MCP server. Credentials are self-serve, but API access is tied to a paid HighLevel subscription starting at $97/month and certain endpoints are restricted to higher tiers. That plan-tier gating makes it moderate rather than easy.
main_blocker: Paid subscription plan required (from $97/mo) plus higher-tier endpoint restrictions
open_questions: Rate limits are referenced in official docs (and a rate-limits page exists at marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/other/rate-limits.md), but that page text was not included in the evidence bundle, so numeric limits are unverified.
Whether a free Marketplace developer account alone (without a paid HighLevel subscription) can obtain working API credentials for testing; sandbox/App Test prerequisites are not fully evidenced.
API V3 is mentioned ('API V3 is available for supported endpoints') but its scope and versioning policy relative to V2 are not detailed in the bundle.
Composio catalog search for 'GoHighLevel' returned zero items; confirm whether a toolkit exists under an alternate name (e.g., 'HighLevel' or 'LeadConnector').
